notes: A tap opens the visible list as a deck at that row, each slide mounting the branchBrief component (estate.js:11490); &detail= is stamped. The deck covers the view pane at lg and the window below it. A deep link to a branch the filter hides opens a deck of one. The scope chips are BRANCH_SCOPES (estate.js:8624); whether they carry counts was not checked. The Activity tab row and search box every Activity pane shares were added after the Activity reader found them missing.

map.js builds its own file deck on swipeDeck (openFileDeck, map.js:6146) rather than calling kits/file-deck.js; Distribution, Harness, Kits and Surfacing share it. The folder rail is map.js markup, shared with Harness. On a phone the reach chips wrap to three rows and the rail follows them, above the list.

Guide over files (branch-brief.js:415): the guide is about the branch, not an index into its files, so no selection binding. The same component is each slide of the Branches deck, so the branch form appears at ring 0 and at ring 3. Not shot: the page needs a #gh= address and data.
